answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own oasis record, and its own share of the dune quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The sparrow ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 653 identities would post 1300 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
